title: Cheesy Venezuelan Sandwich
description: A delicious and savory sandwich filled with venezuelan cheese and seasoned with a hint of jubilant flavor.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the Venezuelan bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Season the cheese with the jubilant seasoning (if using).
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading a layer of sandwich spread on each bread slice.
Place a slice of cheese on each bread slice.
Grill the sandwiches for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the bread is toasted.
